title: Electric Motor Control MONSTER
tagline: Take command of dual mechanical power! Control DC motor speed and stepper angles with an analog joystick.

phases.instructions: Collect the 28BYJ-48 Stepper Motor + ULN2003 Driver Board, 130 DC Motor + L293D Driver IC, Analog Joystick module, and 10k potentiometer.
verificationCheckpoints: ULN2003 driver board with 4 red indicator LEDs ready
L293D dual H-bridge motor driver chip ready

phases.instructions: Connect ULN2003 inputs to pins 8-11. Connect L293D PWM enable to Pin 5 and direction to Pin 4. Connect Joystick X to A0 and Y to A1.
verificationCheckpoints: Joystick connected to A0 and A1

phases.instructions: Check that the DC motor has a flyback suppression capacitor or diode across its terminals to prevent inductive voltage spikes from damaging the Arduino.
verificationCheckpoints: Motor wiring clear of breadboard shorts
Motor shafts free to spin without obstruction

phases.instructions: Study how Stepper library generates 4-phase step sequences while analogRead maps joystick displacement to PWM motor speed.
phases.codeExplanation:
- myStepper(2048, 8, 10, 9, 11) initializes 4-step sequence for internal 64:1 reduction gearing.
- Pushing joystick X left/right steps the motor in discrete micro-steps.
- Pushing joystick Y controls DC motor PWM speed and rotational direction.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand difference between continuous DC rotation vs discrete stepper stepping
Understand PWM speed control with analogWrite

phases.instructions: Upload sketch and maneuver joystick in all directions to verify simultaneous stepper indexing and DC motor variable throttle.
verificationCheckpoints: Stepper indexes smoothly with joystick X
DC motor accelerates smoothly with joystick Y

phases.instructions: Command deck operational! You mastered multi-motor control across both continuous and stepper domains.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Motor Dynamo badge

variants.title: Encoder Speed Controller
variants.description: Replace standard potentiometer with a rotary encoder for detented digital speed steps.
variants.wiringDifferences: Connect rotary encoder CLK to Pin 2 and DT to Pin 3
variants.codeAdaptation: Use pin change interrupts or polling to increment/decrement PWM duty cycle

extensionMissions.title: Soft-Start Ramp Profiler
extensionMissions.objective: Prevent motor stall and current spikes by smoothly accelerating motor PWM from 0 to target speed over 1.5 seconds.
hints: Use a timer loop to increment PWM by 5 every 30ms until reaching targetPWM

story: Build a Dual Motor Control command deck! Harness analog joystick vectors to drive both a high-speed DC motor (via L293D H-Bridge driver) and a precision 28BYJ-48 stepper motor (via ULN2003 Darlington array).

troubleshooting.symptom: Stepper motor vibrates and buzzes but does not rotate
troubleshooting.cause: Sequence coil pins 9 and 10 are reversed in stepper constructor
troubleshooting.solution: Use pin order (8, 10, 9, 11) in Stepper constructor for 28BYJ-48 motors.
diagnosticSteps: Check 4-phase sequence wires (IN1 to IN4) on driver board.
Ensure 5V power supply has enough current (>500mA).
